## Section 2

Here is an R code example:

```r
# Calculate mean and standard deviation
data <- c(23, 45, 67, 89, 12, 34, 56)
mean_value <- mean(data)
sd_value <- sd(data)

cat("Mean:", mean_value, "\n")
cat("Standard Deviation:", sd_value, "\n")
```
